labels.name: Uvea
labels.function: Inflamed in this disease: painful red eye; ask about family history

labels.name: Sternoclavicular joint
labels.function: Upper-chest joint that can join the peripheral polyarthritis

labels.name: Rib cage
labels.function: Moves less with a deep breath on the bedside expansion test

labels.name: Aortic valve
labels.function: Becomes leaky (regurgitant) when the aorta is inflamed

labels.name: Lumbar vertebral column
labels.function: Fuses into a bamboo shape on x-ray; osteopenic and fractures easily

labels.name: Sacroiliac joint
labels.function: Tender on Mennell sign; sclerosis and erosions on x-ray

labels.name: Hip joint
labels.function: Large ball-and-socket joint involved in the polyarthritis

labels.name: Distal interphalangeal joint
labels.function: Fingertip joint favored in psoriatic arthritis, unlike in RA

labels.name: Onycholysis
labels.function: Nail detaches from its bed (pits too); worth 1 CASPAR point

labels.name: Dactylitis
labels.function: Whole digit swells like a sausage; in about half of PsA cases

labels.name: Pencil-in-cup deformity
labels.function: Erosion and resorption of bone seen on PsA hand x-ray

labels.name: Ankle joint
labels.function: Leg joint often hit by the post-infectious oligoarthritis

labels.name: Metatarsophalangeal joint
labels.function: Ball-of-foot joint involved in reactive arthritis

labels.name: Keratoderma blennorrhagica
labels.function: Hyperkeratotic palm and sole lesions after a triggering infection
